title: processing.shape_check.ShapeCheckReport
---



```python
processing.shape_check.ShapeCheckReport(
    n_overlap,
    corr,
    range_ratio,
    min_corr,
    min_range_ratio,
)
```

Immutable result of a forecast shape plausibility check.

All numeric fields reflect the overlap intersection of ``y`` and
``reference``; ``n_overlap`` is the count of aligned index positions.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name            | Type             | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|-----------------|------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| n_overlap       | [int](`int`)     | Number of aligned (overlapping) index positions used for the computation.  When this is below the evaluable minimum the ``skipped`` property returns ``True`` and ``corr`` / ``range_ratio`` are ``float('nan')``. |
| corr            | [float](`float`) | Pearson correlation between ``y`` and ``reference`` over the overlap.  ``float('nan')`` when ``n_overlap < min_overlap`` or when the computation fails (e.g. zero-variance series).                                |
| range_ratio     | [float](`float`) | ``(y.max() - y.min()) / (reference.max() - reference.min())`` over the overlap.  ``float('nan')`` when ``n_overlap < min_overlap`` or when the reference range is zero.                                            |
| min_corr        | [float](`float`) | Minimum acceptable Pearson correlation (passed through from ``check_forecast_shape``).                                                                                                                             |
| min_range_ratio | [float](`float`) | Minimum acceptable range ratio (passed through from ``check_forecast_shape``).                                                                                                                                     |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}


::: {#5f17b62e .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
from spotforecast2_safe.processing.shape_check import ShapeCheckReport
import math

r = ShapeCheckReport(
    n_overlap=24, corr=0.85, range_ratio=0.9,
    min_corr=0.6, min_range_ratio=0.5,
)
assert r.plausible
assert not r.skipped
print("plausible:", r.plausible, "skipped:", r.skipped)

# NaN correlation -> not plausible
r_nan = ShapeCheckReport(
    n_overlap=24, corr=float("nan"), range_ratio=0.9,
    min_corr=0.6, min_range_ratio=0.5,
)
assert not r_nan.plausible
print("NaN corr -> plausible:", r_nan.plausible)
```
